import mir_eval
import numpy as np

# Define deterministic intervals to test onset matching
# Tolerance is 0.05s by default.
# 0.52 is within 0.05 of 0.5 (match)
# 1.6 is NOT within 0.05 of 1.5 (no match)
ref_int = np.array([[0.5, 1.0], [1.5, 2.0]])
est_int = np.array([[0.52, 0.9], [1.6, 2.1]])

precision, recall, f_measure = mir_eval.transcription.onset_precision_recall_f1(
    ref_int, est_int, onset_tolerance=0.05
)

# 1 match out of 2 references and 2 estimates yields 0.5 for all metrics
assert precision == 0.5, f"Expected precision 0.5, got {precision}"
assert recall == 0.5, f"Expected recall 0.5, got {recall}"
assert f_measure == 0.5, f"Expected f_measure 0.5, got {f_measure}"

print(f"__CHECK__ onset_precision_recall_f1 {precision:.2f}, {recall:.2f}, {f_measure:.2f}")
